Egis Technology Inc (神盾) yesterday signed a strategic partnership with French processor designer SiPearl to jointly develop central processing units (CPU), targeting high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI) and data center applications.

The partnership links Egis’ ARM-based Mobius100 (M100) CPU project with SiPearl, combining Taiwanese and French technology and commercial resources to advance processor development, Egis said in a statement.

Egis, which started as a fingerprint sensor designer, has expanded its product portfolio through its subsidiaries into silicon intellectual property, universal chiplet interconnect express technology, advanced packaging and server CPUs.

Egis’ 3-nanometer chiplet is expected to tape out in the first quarter of next year, with mass production slated for the second half of 2028, Egis chairman Steve Ro (羅森洲) told reporters on the sidelines of a signing ceremony for the SiPearl collaboration.
